examples.en: He is a master at name-dropping and meaningless Hollywood doubletalk.
examples.zh: 他善于靠名人名字来抬高自己的身价，并爱讲一些毫无意义的好莱坞式模棱两可的话。

examples.en: These tests were so seriously flawed as to render the results meaningless.
examples.zh: 这些测试存在着如此严重的缺陷，以至于使得结果毫无意义。

examples.en: The essay was a meaningless jumble of ideas.
examples.zh: 这篇散文思想混乱，使人不知所云。
